resources.string: Placental exchange: marker reaching the fetal side
Starting marker on the maternal side
Two equal model volumes start with marker only on one side. Transferred marker = half the starting amount × selected progress toward equal shares.
Remaining on the maternal side: %1$s model units

The placenta keeps maternal and fetal blood in separate circulations while some substances cross the exchange surface. This equal-volume example tracks a fictional marker only. It does not estimate transfer for any real substance, pregnancy, or medication.
Two sides of the exchange surface
Blood stays on its own side. At the selected finish: %1$s marker units on the maternal side, %2$s on the fetal side.
